title: Swift: GameModeView resolves the focused card to a real id
description: GameModeView.focusedCardIndex becomes focusedCardID (resolves the D-pad-focused array index to that entry's real id) and Grid's own SkinWebGridView call site is updated to pass it. Steam-style/Spotlight aren't wired yet - separate piece.
commit_message: Resolve GameModeView's focused card to an id, wire into Grid
